pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed treadmill behavioral training across multiple paradigms: cue-free belt, cue-rich belt random foraging, context remapping, and Goal-Oriented Learning

parameters.cue_rich_belt: 2 m, 3 joined fabric ribbons with tactile cues (pompoms, velcro, glue-gun spikes, foam, glitter tape)

pipeline_steps.technique: AOD-based chessboard-scanning two-photon calcium imaging of molecularly targeted interneurons across multiple days, guided by a reference structural Z-stack

parameters.reference_stack: 800x800 px, 1.25 um/px, 4 um z-step, from stratum oriens/alveus to stratum lacunosum-moleculare
parameters.roi_definition: chessboard scan, 40-50 um^2 squares at 1-1.5 um/px resolution, centered on 200-300 manually identified X-Y-Z cell coordinates
parameters.functional_session: 10-15 min, 3-5 Hz (or 40 Hz/30 cells for contralateral LFP experiments)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw chessboard-scanned two-photon GCaMP6f time series per identified interneuron
pipeline_steps.hardware: Femto3D-ATLAS AOD microscope (Femtonics); Coherent Ultra II laser; Hamamatsu H10770PA-40 GaAsP PMTs

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic contralateral silicon-probe implantation for LFP recording synchronized with imaging, and automated sharp-wave-ripple detection

parameters.probe: 4-channel silicon probe (Qtrode, Neuronexus), 45-degree angle into contralateral CA1
parameters.recording_system: Intan Technologies multichannel system, 20 kHz, synchronized with AOD imaging
parameters.swr_detection: band-pass filter 100-250 Hz, threshold 3 s.d. above mean, minimum duration 50 ms, followed by manual inspection

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected sharp-wave-ripple event times
pipeline_steps.hardware: Qtrode silicon probe; Intan Technologies recording system

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-imaging perfusion, sectioning, and sequential multi-round immunohistochemistry for interneuron subtype marker panels (PV, SOM, NPY, CCK, SATB1, CR, VIP, M2R)

parameters.perfusion: 40 mL ice-cold PBS then 40 mL ice-cold 4% PFA
parameters.staining_strategies: 3 sequential 2-round antibody combinations in VGAT-Cre mice (proCCK/SOM/NPY + PV/SATB1; PV/SOM/SATB1 + proCCK/NPY; PV/SOM/VIP + CR/NPY), 1 round in VIP-Cre mice (proCCK/CR/M2R)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: multi-round immunolabeled tissue sections

pipeline_steps.technique: Confocal imaging of immunolabeled sections, registration to in vivo two-photon Z-stacks, and manual per-cell immunopositivity classification into interneuron subtypes

parameters.confocal: Nikon A1, 405/488/561/640 nm lines, 10x/0.45 NA objective, 1.2-1.3x zoom, 2048x2048 px, ~3 um z-step, ~1 Airy unit pinhole
parameters.registration: manual rotation/translation to match GCaMP-labeled cells between confocal and in vivo Z-stacks
parameters.classification_rule: positive only if intracellular fluorescence clearly exceeds background with confirmable negative examples on the same section; ambiguous cells discarded
parameters.subtype_categories: AAC, PVBC, BiC, SomC, CCKC, IvC/NGFC, ISI1, ISI2, ISI3, VIP+/CR-, VIP+/CCK+, VIP+/M2R+, PV+, unidentified

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: confocal immunofluorescence z-stacks and in vivo reference Z-stacks
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell molecular subtype identity

pipeline_steps.technique: Pre-processing of calcium imaging data: whole-frame motion correction, manual ROI drawing, neuropil-corrected fluorescence extraction, and DF/F baseline calculation

parameters.roi: hand-drawn on time-averaged image per cell
parameters.baseline: 1st percentile in a rolling 30 s window (adaptive) or 1st percentile of the whole trace (static, for immobility analyses)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, neuropil-corrected DF/F traces per cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Locomotion-related activity analysis: lagged cross-correlation between each cell's DF/F and running velocity, and run-start/run-stop event-triggered response quantification
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell velocity correlation/lag and run-start/run-stop response magnitudes

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning curve calculation with shuffle-based spatial-selectivity testing, linear-SVM position decoding, and stability/context-remapping/context-decoding analyses

parameters.spatial_bins: 100 bins (2 cm) over a 2 m treadmill, locomotion frames only (velocity > 5 cm/s)
parameters.shuffle_test: 1000 circular-shift shuffles, 95th/5th percentile threshold, >=10 consecutive bins and peak >100% DF/F
parameters.context_decoder: linear SVM trained on 20/40/60/80% of laps, 100 repeats
parameters.stability_metric: Pearson correlation of odd- vs. even-lap tuning curves
parameters.remapping_metric: Pearson correlation of tuning curves across belts, rotation-optimized

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning curves, spatial-selectivity calls, decoding accuracy, stability/remapping correlations

pipeline_steps.technique: Goal-Oriented-Learning reward-modulation-index analysis and multivariate ridge regression decomposing each cell's spatial tuning into velocity, licking, and position predictors

parameters.reward_modulation_index: (activity near reward zone - activity elsewhere) / sum, 10 cm reward-zone window
parameters.regression_model: Ridge regression, predictors = velocity, licking, and 5 position-zone indicators

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial tuning curves and behavioral variables
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: reward modulation index and per-subtype regression coefficients

pipeline_steps.technique: Sharp-wave-ripple modulation analysis (event-triggered average response and shuffle-based per-event modulation probability), Bayesian Gaussian-mixture clustering of modulation profiles, Type-III-ISI transient detection, immobility-epoch dynamics, and pairwise inter-subtype correlation analysis

parameters.swr_modulation_shuffle: 1000 values per cell from randomly sampled immobility DF/F points, 95th-percentile threshold per event
parameters.gmm_clustering: Bayesian Gaussian mixture model, k-means-initialized weights, group count inferred from data
parameters.transient_detection: peak in Z-scored trace, threshold 0.3 sigma, minimum 15-frame (~2 s) horizontal distance
parameters.immobility_criterion: velocity < 0.2 cm/s for >= 15-20 s, intervals upsampled to common length and averaged

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: DF/F traces and detected SWR event times
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: SWR modulation probability/clusters, transient times, immobility response profiles, inter-subtype correlation coefficients

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro whole-cell patch-clamp recording of Unc5b-CreER neurons
